daily.brief: 從11月11日晚到13日凌晨，市場有395則帖、119個帳號在討論。最大變化是NVDA執行長相關醜聞與辭職風波，盤後股價跌約8%，Bernstein把目標價從400美元下調，本周市值損失大約6000億美元。共識清楚偏向AMD和AAPL創新高，GOOGL也強勢回到300。NVDA本身看好和看淡各有10個帳號，嚴重分歧，SMCI則因為相關調查成為少數明確看淡的名字。
daily.full:
共識

AMD是這段最乾淨的共識。9個帳號看好、零看淡，股價創新高+6.5%。@3PeaksTrading同時點出$AVGO也+7%，$GOOGL強勢回到300。原帖。@TrendSpider直接說ORB給了綠燈。原帖。FuturumEquities那邊提到主持人在創紀錄季度及17%下跌後給出判決，@StockSavvyShay看漲，雖然有人說「繩子很短」。

AAPL同樣多人支持，剛剛創下歷史新高。@StockSavvyShay點出這一點，@munster_gene則說它有穿透節日營銷噪音的超能力。原帖。@MikeZaccardi形容它是一家孤獨的超過4萬億公司。原帖。

GOOGL也有聲音，@Mr_Derivatives說它現在接近超越NVDA成為世界第三大公司，幾週前Nvidia還是第一。原帖。DeItaone引HSBC「不要浪費一個好的拋售」，把Alphabet列為買入。原帖。

共同看淡

只有SMCI較明確。2個帳號看淡，股價跌約13%。@wallstengine引彭博報導，美國正調查Alice Huang是否協助透過Super Micro走私NVIDIA動力伺服器。原帖。@tenet_research指出司法部有三項獨立調查，涉及NVDA、Megaspeed和Super Micro，一項針對反壟斷，跟Huang辭職的餘波在華盛頓擴散有關。原帖。

分歧

NVDA是絕對主角，205則帖、76個帳號，看好和看淡剛好各10個。@StockSavvyShay認為無論誰成為下一任CEO，未來幾年都將有大量現金用於股份回購。原帖。@fundstrat說逢低買入，明天NVDA仍將是世界上最重要的公司，遺憾看到Jensen離開，他仍將建造偉大事物。原帖。但@Frenchie_詳述與Kimberly Powell的第二段關係，董事會開會可能罷免，盤後已跌8%，本周市值損失約6000億美元，Bernstein將倍數與目標價從400美元下調。原帖。@RampCapitalLLC那邊有人覺得「Jensen走了，CFO在經營公司，沒人知道現在誰穿皮夾克」，風險太高，但回應暗示仍會買入。原帖。

SPCX偏多但有交鋒。wallstengine提到計劃在亞利桑那州建立價值500億美元、6GW的超級計算園區。原帖。StockSavvyShay補充德州Starbase超過240億，以及亞利桑那據報500億的園區，僅這兩個就有超過740億潛在美國投資。原帖。

QQQ有人看到儘管Jensen消息，指數轉綠，逢低買入NVDA的資金進來，NAS100抹去早前損失轉正。原帖。

其他值得留意

SPY有4個帳號看好。3PeaksTrading說早盤回調讓四月看漲期權回到9美元，現在迅速回到11以上，昨天有大額Nov 27看漲買入，像這樣的回調是加倉時機。原帖。ACInvestorBlog則直接說給末日先知們，所有美國指數都是綠色。ASTS、LUNR也有一些看好聲音。
daily.html:
短摘要

NVDA領導層風波主導討論，盤後大跌，Bernstein下調目標價。AMD和AAPL創新高獲共識看好，GOOGL接近市值第三。395則帖、119個帳號中，NVDA 10對10嚴重分歧，SMCI因調查被看淡。

weekly.brief: 過去7日（11月7日至13日）有545則帖、133個帳號。AMD持續是最明確的共識看好，11個帳號沒有看淡，SPY、AAPL、GOOGL也有支持。NVDA仍是最大熱點（247提及）但11對10意見分裂，沒有其他明顯共同看淡。SMCI是唯一較清楚的看淡名字。
weekly.full:
共識

AMD在這週持續獲看好，11個帳號明確支持，創新高相關討論延續。SPY有6個、AAPL和GOOGL各4個、AVGO 3個。ASTS、LUNR、BE也有一些聲音。整體AI相關芯片和指數有多個帳號站在多頭。

共同看淡

只有SMCI。2個帳號看淡，主要因司法部調查Alice Huang是否協助走私NVIDIA伺服器，以及與NVDA相關的多項調查，股價跌約13%。

分歧

NVDA依舊最大分歧，247則帖、83個帳號，看好11個、看淡10個。有人認為回購會繼續、逢低買入，有人聚焦董事會可能行動和市值蒸發。SPCX、NBIS、QQQ、MU、CRWV也有多空交錯，記憶體和雲端名字反應不一。

其他值得留意

太空相關ASTS、LUNR有進展討論。整體AI資本支出故事未變，但短期情緒被NVDA個人新聞干擾。
weekly.html:
短摘要

一週內AMD是最明確的共識看好（11個帳號），NVDA大分歧持續。545則帖中沒有其他共同看淡，SMCI因調查被點名。

monthly.brief: 過去28日（10月17日至11月13日）有5607則帖、215個帳號，討論量最大。AMD、SOFI等有較強共識看好，RDDT有9個帳號看淡。大市SPY、NVDA、SPCX、TSLA意見分裂嚴重，CRWV和INTC則偏空聲音較多。AI主題仍是主軸，但個別公司事件和估值分歧明顯。
monthly.full:
共識

AMD長期仍獲支持，14個帳號看好。SOFI有9個，SKHY、RSP各5個。一些消費和防禦股如MA、ISRG、LMT、MCD也有共識。整體有75個共識看好名字。

共同看淡

RDDT有9個帳號看淡。BA 4個、FTNT、BABA、RBLX各3個。部分科技和消費名字有較一致的負面看法。

分歧

SPY、NVDA、SPCX、TSLA是最大分歧，提及數百次。有人認為AI資本支出故事未變，短期恐懼會過去；有人擔心估值和個別風險。CRWV偏空聲音較多（19看淡對5看好），INTC也是。QQQ、META等也有交鋒。

其他值得留意

NBIS、PLTR、AVGO等AI相關持續有討論。市場輪動和個股事件影響較大，28日數據顯示共識和分歧同時存在。
monthly.html:
短摘要

28日大數據中AMD等有共識，RDDT等被看淡。SPY和NVDA等大票意見分裂，AI主題延續但分歧加大。5607則帖來自215個帳號。

今日重點

NVDA執行長相關醜聞和辭職風波主導討論，盤後跌約8%，Bernstein把目標價從400美元下調，本周市值損失約6000億。AMD創新高+6.5%獲9個帳號共識看好，AAPL也創歷史新高，GOOGL接近超越成為市值第三。NVDA本身10對10嚴重分歧，SMCI因司法部調查Alice Huang走私NVIDIA伺服器被看淡。

一週和一個月來看，AMD共識較強，大市和AI龍頭則持續分歧。短期沒有其他明顯共同看淡。

daily.brief: From the evening of Nov 11 to early Nov 13, there were 395 posts from 119 accounts. The biggest shift is the scandal and resignation fallout around the NVDA CEO, with the stock down about 8% after hours, Bernstein cutting its target from $400, and roughly $600 billion in market cap lost this week. Consensus clearly favors AMD and AAPL at new highs, with GOOGL also strong back to 300. Views on NVDA itself are evenly split 10-10, while SMCI is one of the few clear bearish names due to related probes.
daily.full:
Consensus

AMD is the cleanest consensus. 9 accounts bullish, zero bearish, stock at new highs +6.5%. @3PeaksTrading notes $AVGO also +7% and $GOOGL strong back to 300. original post. @TrendSpider says ORB gave the green light. original post. FuturumEquities mentioned hosts giving a verdict after a record quarter and 17% drop, with @StockSavvyShay bullish, though some call the leash short.

AAPL also draws support, just hitting a new all-time high. @StockSavvyShay pointed it out, @munster_gene says it has the superpower to cut through holiday marketing noise. original post. @MikeZaccardi calls it a lonely company over $4 trillion. original post.

GOOGL has support too. @Mr_Derivatives says it is close to overtaking NVDA as the world's third-largest company. original post. DeItaone cites HSBC saying don't waste a good sell-off and listing Alphabet as a buy. original post.

Joint Bearish

Only SMCI is clearer. 2 accounts bearish, stock down about 13%. @wallstengine cites Bloomberg that the US is investigating whether Alice Huang helped smuggle NVIDIA-powered servers via Super Micro. original post. @tenet_research notes three independent DOJ probes involving NVDA, Megaspeed and Super Micro, tied to the Huang resignation fallout in Washington. original post.

Divergence

NVDA is the absolute protagonist with 205 posts and 76 accounts, exactly 10 bullish and 10 bearish. @StockSavvyShay thinks whoever becomes the next CEO, there will be plenty of cash for buybacks in the coming years. original post. @fundstrat says buy the dip, tomorrow NVDA will still be the most important company in the world, sad to see Jensen leave but he will still build great things. original post. Meanwhile @Frenchie_ details the second relationship with Kimberly Powell, possible board meeting to remove him, already down 8% after hours, ~$600B market cap loss this week, and Bernstein cutting the multiple and target from $400. original post. @RampCapitalLLC has some saying the risk is too high because Jensen is gone, the CFO is running the company, and no one knows who wears the leather jacket now, though replies suggest people will still buy. original post.

SPCX leans bullish with some back-and-forth. wallstengine noted plans for a $50 billion, 6GW supercomputing campus in Arizona. original post. StockSavvyShay added over $24B at Texas Starbase plus the reported $50B Arizona campus. original post.

QQQ saw some noting the index turned green despite the Jensen news as dip-buyers stepped into NVDA. original post.

Other Notable

SPY has 4 bullish accounts. 3PeaksTrading said the early pullback took April call options back to $9, now quickly back above $11, and yesterday's large Nov 27 call buys make such dips an add. original post. ACInvestorBlog told the doomsayers that all US indices are green. ASTS and LUNR also drew some supportive voices.
daily.html:
Short summary

NVDA leadership fallout dominates discussion with an after-hours drop and Bernstein target cut from $400. AMD and AAPL hit new highs with clear consensus support, GOOGL near No. 3 by market cap. Among 395 posts and 119 accounts, NVDA is evenly split 10-10 while SMCI is bearish on the probe.

weekly.brief: Over the past 7 days (Nov 7 to 13): 545 posts from 133 accounts. AMD remains the clearest consensus long with 11 accounts and no bears. SPY, AAPL and GOOGL also see support. NVDA is still the hottest name (247 mentions) but split 11-10. SMCI is the only clearer bearish name.
weekly.full:
Consensus

AMD continued to attract bullish views with 11 accounts. SPY has 6, AAPL and GOOGL 4 each, AVGO 3. ASTS, LUNR and BE also have some support. Several AI-related chip and index names have multiple accounts on the long side.

Joint Bearish

Only SMCI. 2 accounts bearish, mainly on the DOJ probe into whether Alice Huang helped smuggle NVIDIA servers and related investigations, with the stock down about 13%.

Divergence

NVDA remains the largest split with 247 posts and 83 accounts (11 bull / 10 bear). Some focus on continued buybacks and dip-buying; others on possible board action and market-cap evaporation. SPCX, NBIS, QQQ, MU and CRWV also show mixed takes.

Other Notable

Space names such as ASTS and LUNR continue to draw interest. The broader AI capex story is unchanged but short-term sentiment is noisy from the NVDA personal news.
weekly.html:
Short summary

AMD is the clearest consensus long over the week with 11 accounts. NVDA divergence continues. 545 posts show no other joint bearish names besides SMCI on the probe.

monthly.brief: Over the past 28 days (Oct 17 to Nov 13): 5607 posts from 215 accounts. AMD and SOFI show relatively strong consensus support while RDDT draws 9 bearish accounts. Large names such as SPY, NVDA, SPCX and TSLA remain heavily split. CRWV and INTC lean more bearish. AI remains the main theme but company-specific events and valuation debates are wide.
monthly.full:
Consensus

AMD retains longer-term support with 14 accounts. SOFI has 9, SKHY and RSP 5 each. Some consumer and defense names such as MA, ISRG, LMT and MCD also show agreement. There are 75 consensus bullish names overall.

Joint Bearish

RDDT has 9 bearish accounts. BA has 4, FTNT, BABA and RBLX have 3 each. Some tech and consumer names see more aligned negative takes.

Divergence

SPY, NVDA, SPCX and TSLA are the largest split names with hundreds of mentions. Some argue the AI capex story is intact and fear will fade; others focus on valuation and single-name risks. CRWV shows more bearish voices (19 bear vs 5 bull). QQQ and META also have back-and-forth.

Other Notable

NBIS, PLTR and AVGO remain active in AI discussions. Rotation and single-stock events continue to matter across the 28-day window.
monthly.html:
Short summary

In the 28-day window AMD and others have consensus support while RDDT draws bearish views. SPY and NVDA remain split. AI theme persists but divergence is wider across 5607 posts from 215 accounts.

briefing.html:
Today's brief

The NVDA CEO scandal and resignation fallout dominate discussion. The stock is down about 8% after hours, Bernstein cut its target from $400, and roughly $600B in market cap was lost this week. AMD hit new highs +6.5% with clear support from 9 accounts, AAPL also made a new all-time high, and GOOGL is close to becoming the third-largest company. NVDA itself is evenly split 10-10, while SMCI is bearish on the DOJ probe into Alice Huang and NVIDIA servers.

Over the week and month, AMD shows stronger consensus while broad market and AI leaders remain split. No other clear joint bearish names in the short term.
